summary: Backend testing completed for 2 bug fixes: (1) BOM rollup cost in SC lines, (2) JW GRN invoice validation. 29/31 tests passed, 2 skipped. Both bug fixes verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test data created dynamically with TEST_ prefix for items (RM, SA, FG), suppliers, BOMs, routings, production orders, work orders, SC orders, DCs, and GRNs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixes verified: (1) JW GRN invoice validation - POST /api/job-work/receive-grn now returns 400 if supplier_invoice_no or supplier_invoice_date is missing. (2) BOM rollup cost - create-sc endpoint uses calc_bom_rollup helper to calculate material + process costs for completed parts. When SA is not completed, smart_resolve resolves it to RM components with their unit_costs. Regression tests passed for create-sc with_material, without_material, and DC creation.

bug_1_bom_rollup_cost.details: calc_bom_rollup helper calculates material_cost (sum of comp_qty * comp_unit_cost) + process_cost (from completed WO operations_status). smart_resolve uses this for completed parts. When SA is not completed, it resolves to RM components.

bug_2_jw_grn_invoice_validation.details: POST /api/job-work/receive-grn returns 400 'Supplier Invoice No. is mandatory' if supplier_invoice_no is missing, and 400 'Supplier Invoice Date is mandatory' if supplier_invoice_date is missing.

regression_create_sc_with_material.details: create-sc endpoint works correctly for with_material type - SC lines contain RM items

regression_create_sc_without_material.details: create-sc endpoint works correctly for without_material type - SC lines contain FG item

regression_dc_creation.details: DC creation works correctly - stock is deducted from RM items

jw_grn_adds_stock_completes_sc.details: JW GRN adds stock to SA/FG items and completes SC when all parts are fully received

tests_skipped: TestBOMRollupCostInSCLines::test_09_create_work_order_for_sa - SA WO creation requires separate PO
